newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares surge, break 3-day losing streak.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares surge, break 3-day losing streak.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended a three-day losing streak of hefty losses on Friday, jumping 5.72 percent as the market digested the surprise move by the central bank on tightening foreign trading activity.
"It seems like the panic after recent losses has ebbed and the market is now returning to its upward trek," Andrej Obed, a trader at A banka said.
* The SBI index soared 74.12 points to 1,369.4.
* Overall 13 shares rose, two fell and two were unchanged, while eight were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek's A share was the most active, firming 4.08 percent to 27,060 tolars on volume of 4,707 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, +38 61 125 8439
